findings.rule: a test pins that the render names no organisation (as for the session store)
findings.input: A rendered waybill file that gains the text `acme-corp/widgets@1a2b3c`, or `acme-corp/widgets` followed by a space, or the bare name `Acme Corp`
findings.finding: The test only collects owners from `owner/repo` followed by `#<digits>` or `:`, so an organisation named in any other form passes it, whereas the session store's test rejects the name wherever it appears in a rendered file.

findings.rule: **The order-name rule for orgs with several repos:** a name ends in the reviewed repository's short code and the pull request's number (`review-spec-fidelity-opus-<code><n>`), because each repository numbers its pull requests from 1; the short code is the one the repository's branch names use.
findings.input: An org whose branches for `my-org/my-repo` carry the code `mr` (`claude/mr4-fix`) and whose `shortcodes.json` lists `"my-org/my-repo": "repo"`
findings.finding: The rendered README and AGENTS.md never say that an order's short code is the one the repository's branch names use; the README points to a separate, waybill-owned `shortcodes.json` that nothing ties to the branch pattern's codes, so the order `review-spec-fidelity-opus-repo4` follows the stamped rule.

findings.rule: The answers file records only `agentic_subtemplate: waybill`: the waybill needs nothing from the org, so no org name is stamped in.
findings.finding: `agentic_actions_runner` has no `when` in copier.yml and the order check renders it, so the answers file also records `agentic_actions_runner: ubuntu-latest`, and the test that carries the sentence's name asserts only that two other keys are absent.

findings.rule: **`.github/workflows/order-check.yml`:** pandoscope/waybill's check, rendered with the template's runner; it matches the original apart from two Pandoscope ticket references dropped from a comment.
findings.input: `diff` of pandoscope/waybill's `.github/workflows/order-check.yml` against the default render, lines 3 to 6
findings.finding: The header comment is reworded beyond the two dropped references (`must validate` became `validates`, the semicolon a colon, the lines rewrapped), so the render differs from the original in more than the body states, though in no executed line.
